description: Canonical AFKSwitch support matrix. scripts/validate.py renders it into the README, docs/details.md and spec/presence.md (python scripts/validate.py --write) and fails when they drift.

levels.state-only: Durable local presence state through the state protocol.
levels.notify: State-only, plus telling live peer sessions through a native host mechanism, with honest delivery reporting.
levels.fan-in: Notify, plus requesting and consolidating a status from each peer on /back, human blockers first.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.summary: Every live local session that the host confirms delivery to is told, and /back collects a status from each.
